minimum_test.proof: Every four-cycle of total cost at most K has an arc of cost at most floor(K/4). Every such finite anchor and its exact three-step min-plus return were tested.

physical_filter.safe_filter: For a target board, replacing every physical side realization by its abstract minimum gives a supported cycle of cost at least the global minimum. Hence total physical excess is at most target minus global minimum, and each individual corner realization has excess at most that allowance.

support_union.completeness: Union of complete exact four-cycle supports at every integral cost from the certified boundary minimum through the full target budget.

theorem.physical_completeness: All physical depth-five corners are enumerated. A corner is retained exactly when its excess over a supported side minimum fits the target slack, then quotiented only by its exact exposed-frontier connectivity future.
theorem.support_completeness: Every directed four-cycle of total charge at most 48 has an arc of charge at most 12. Every such anchor and every exact three-arc return is included by min-plus support.
